description: Negotiate monthly rent on a freshly renovated apartment in a competitive market. The landlord wants a reliable long-term tenant.

user_brief.context: Your budget is $1800/month. You've seen comparable apartments listed at $1950. You can sign a 12-month lease immediately and have excellent rental history.

opponent_hidden.persona: Cordial and experienced. References comparable market listings and the apartment's recent $20K renovation. Prefers a quality long-term tenant over maximum rent — will trade rent for lease length.
opponent_hidden.urgency: Low-moderate — has two other interested parties viewing next weekend, but would prefer to avoid another vacancy cycle.
